purpose: Join the existing structured exact-CMLE calibration workflow, fixed-calibration WLE Person scoring, untrimmed Person MnSq, and raw-versus-display decision audit into a Streamlit-free six-card result contract without changing an estimator, numerical gate, or public capability claim.

presentation_boundary_probe.rule: All card counts and statuses use finite unrounded MnSq. Display values and their counterfactual labels are explanatory evidence only.

card_contract.uncertainty: The final card is always withheld in v1 because WLE SE treats fitted CMLE calibration as fixed and ZSTD, p-values, interval coverage, and total SE are not qualified.
card_contract.anchors: Show supplied anchored main-effect levels separately from free coordinates and warn that exact enforcement cannot validate anchor content.
card_contract.extremes: Show exact-extreme Person counts as caution, not as unavailable WLE, because Warm WLE is the explicit finite correction in this lane.

success_gates.identity: Every parent SHA-256 matches before a run.
success_gates.status_accounting: Five analytical cases are retained: two ready-with-cautions and one each input-invalid, design-not-identified, and finite-MLE-boundary.
success_gates.no_forbidden_scoring: Person scoring is attempted exactly twice and never after a blocked calibration workflow.
success_gates.handoff_identity: For both ready cases, WLE estimate, conditional WLE SE, Infit, and Outfit reproduce a direct call on the same fitted calibration within 1e-12 and Person identities match exactly.
success_gates.anchors: The ready PCM case reports both supplied anchors exactly with SE zero, anchored count two, and a persistent anchor-validity warning.
success_gates.cards: Every case returns the same six ordered bilingual cards and one summary row, including blocked/not-run downstream states.
success_gates.rounding: The presentation probe records one raw/display mismatch; the raw noisy class drives the card and is never replaced by the displayed acceptable class.
success_gates.scope: Calibration uncertainty, ZSTD, p-values, confidence intervals, total SE, new-Person scoring, automatic estimator fallback, and public Streamlit exposure remain withheld.
success_gates.tests: New one-click contract tests and the selected CMLE workflow/scoring/fit/anchor suites pass.

interpretation_limits.one_click: One function call is an orchestration contract, not usability or comprehension evidence.
interpretation_limits.fit: MnSq zones are descriptive threshold rules and do not establish model truth.
interpretation_limits.rounding: Absence of a three-decimal mismatch in a finite fixture is not a general precision guarantee.
interpretation_limits.anchors: Exact anchors can transmit bias and do not establish a common scale.
interpretation_limits.generalization: The evidence does not cover high-dimensional sparse PCM, step/group anchors, GPCM, unseen Persons/units, independent calibration, or a clean released mfrmr comparison.
